split_metadata.group_definition: Identical values across the six shared V1 baseline features
split_metadata.note: Same row indices are used for V1, V2 and V3. A zero overlap confirms no identical full feature vector from the held-out test rows appears in training for that version.

threshold_selection: Group-isolated validation split only; target recall 0.75
note: Both the internal validation split and final test split are group-isolated using the six shared baseline features. Threshold is selected using a model fitted on the sub-training split, then that model is refitted on all training rows before test evaluation. Probability calibration can shift slightly after refitting; interpret the tuned-threshold metrics with this limitation in mind.
